title: CompactionPacket
description: The cited continuation packet a Longshoreman (or the body itself) builds when context pressure crosses a threshold (binder ch04 'How Longshoremen compact Voyagers'; ch07 M6 gate: 'force context threshold and see compaction packet; resume successor from packet and transcript'). It is the payload of the first-class `compaction_packet` transcript event (ch04/ch09) and the successor's primary context source. CITATION RULE (ADR-0097, normative): every factual claim carries at least one citation back to a transcript event span, a file, or a claim — 'a compaction that cannot be traced back is too easy to hallucinate' (ch04). The validator FAILS uncited factual claims and WARNS when active obligations are missing; its result is embedded here so a consumer can refuse an unvalidated packet. Field names follow ADR-0095 fork resolution 1 (agentNodeId/sessionId/runId); ch04's pre-turn sketch name `agentId` is superseded and must not reappear. CITATION CROSS-FIELD RULE: the frozen F0 keyword subset cannot express conditional requirements, so kind=transcript-event requiring transcriptEventId (and kind=file/claim requiring fileRef/claimRef) is enforced at runtime by the packet validator, the same normative-module pattern as the ADR-0095 witnessing invariant and the ADR-0096 macaroon authorityRef.

sessionId.description: The session being compacted. The successor run joins back to the predecessor transcript through this id.

runId.description: The AgentRun being compacted, when run-scoped (ADR-0095 run-level continuation).

createdBy.description: Who built the packet: a Longshoreman compactor, the body itself, the daemon, or an operator-forced checkpoint.

agentNodeId.description: The compactor's own node id, when an agent built it.

trigger.description: Why compaction happened. Thresholds per ch04: 0.60 prepare, 0.75 Longshoreman builds packet, 0.85 warn, 0.92 require compaction or successor.

pressure.description: used/window ratio at trigger time, from the ContextEnvelope.

contextEnvelopeRef.description: The ContextEnvelope envelopeId this trigger was derived from.

identity.description: Agent identity and role plus the current task (ch04 packet contents list).

operatorInstructions.description: Relevant operator instructions carried forward verbatim.

obligations.description: Active obligation list (required by the ch04 compaction_packet schema). The validator warns when obligations known to the daemon are missing here.

factualClaims.description: Factual claims with source citations. minItems on citations is the schema-level half of the ch04 rule 'the validator fails uncited factual claims'; a claim with an empty citations array is schema-invalid, not merely validator-failed.

items.description: One of: {kind:transcript-event, transcriptEventId, span?} | {kind:file, fileRef} | {kind:claim, claimRef}. Cross-field enforcement is runtime (see top-level description).

span.description: Character span within the cited event's payload, when the claim rests on part of a large payload.

sessionId.description: Disambiguates cross-session citations; defaults to this packet's sessionId.

omittedKnownRisks.description: The omitted-known-risk list (ch04): things the compactor knowingly left out, so the successor inherits the risk knowingly too.

workspace.description: Active files, claims, and worktree covered by this packet (ch04).

diffSummary.description: Current diff summary at compaction time.

commandsRun.description: Commands/tests run and results (ch04), each traceable to its transcript event.

reviewState.description: PR and review state carried forward (ch04).

decisions.description: Decisions made and why (ch04). Cited like factual claims where a decision rests on observed facts.

transcriptExcerpts.description: Recent transcript excerpts BY CITATION (ch04) — the excerpt text is a convenience copy; the citation is the truth.

nextAction.description: Next-action recommendation (ch04) — what the successor should do first.

budgetRemaining.description: USD remaining against the run budget, when known.

sourceTranscript.description: Source hashes (ch04): pins the packet to the exact transcript prefix it summarizes, so 'resume successor from packet and transcript' (M6 gate) verifies against the ledger's per-session hash chain.

headEventId.description: The last transcript event this packet covers.

headHash.description: That event's contentHash — anchors the per-session tamper-evident chain.

validator.description: Validator result (ch04): the validator's whole job is failing uncited factual claims and warning on missing active obligations. A consumer must refuse a packet with passed=false.

transcriptEventId.description: The compaction_packet transcript event that carries this packet, once appended.
